issues.finding: Accepted clarification choices are discarded: clarify removes the question and persists OBSERVING without the chosen choice or a durable resolved-choice handoff. The command table contains only the request digest and public response. A restart/downstream planner cannot consume the user answer, so the advertised clarify command has no durable semantic effect.
issues.suggested_action: Persist a safe scoped selection (question, chosen identity/mapping, coordinate, document and generation) atomically before removing the pending question; expose a trusted consumption seam for OBS-005 and prove restart/idempotent answer recovery without persisting runtime values.

issues.finding: A same-owner lease renewal unconditionally overwrites AWAITING_CLARIFICATION with OBSERVING. The worker can then submit a new observation without a user answer, while the pending answer is rejected as STALE_GENERATION because its required session state disappeared. Ownership maintenance bypasses the frozen clarification state-machine guard.
issues.suggested_action: Separate lease/fence maintenance from workflow transitions. Preserve clarification/auth/finalizing pauses or explicitly invalidate/reissue them through their guarded transition; do not use claim as an unconditional OBSERVING reset. Cover renewal and recoverable takeover during each pause and after finalizing.

issues.finding: Frozen OpenAPI and normative README describe public PlatformBearer JWT authentication, while the public implementation deliberately preserves existing BFF authentication and rejects bearer-only identity. Package README documents the mismatch, but generated consumers still receive an inaccurate contract. No authentication widening was found.
issues.suggested_action: Have the contract owner reconcile the public authentication wording/scheme with the established BFF transport before client integration; preserve the current isolation and do not add JWT auth merely to satisfy the stale wording.
